csv_project_name: Engineering for Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Kitsap Transit is issuing this Request for Qualifications ("RFQ") to solicit proposals from interested, qualified, and experienced firms to provide Preliminary Engineering (including NEPA and permitting support) and design services necessary to advance the phased rehabilitation of the Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal. The selected Consultant team shall support project definition, design criteria development, marine operations needs assessment, focused alternatives analysis, phasing and packaging recommendations, preliminary engineering, environmental and permitting support, design development, cost estimating, and preparation of final bid-ready PS&E documentation, as authorized by Kitsap Transit.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design

title: Engineering for Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal Improvement
short_description: Consulting services for phased rehabilitation and design of Port Orchard intermodal terminal.
project_scope: Preliminary engineering, environmental review, permitting support, design development, cost estimating, and final bid-ready PS&E for the phased rehabilitation of the Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal. Scope includes project definition, design criteria development, marine operations needs assessment, focused alternatives analysis, and phasing and packaging recommendations for an intermodal ferry terminal facility.
services: Preliminary engineering; rehabilitation and refurbishment planning; civil engineering; environmental engineering/planning/design; NEPA and permitting support; cost estimating; design development; preparation of final PS&E documentation.
relevance_explanation:
- Transportation infrastructure project with engineering and design scope.
- Includes rehabilitation/refurbishment and preliminary engineering, which can involve structural input.
- However, the notice focuses on an intermodal terminal and marine operations rather than a clearly defined bridge, roof, or special structural system.
- Environmental, permitting, and general civil scope appear prominent.
- Potentially relevant only if terminal structures include significant structural rehabilitation, which is not specified.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $17.0M.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the source. Available fee-related basis: total construction cost is $17.0M and scope covers preliminary engineering through final bid-ready PS&E, but no reliable consultant fee can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Interested firms must be qualified and experienced in preliminary engineering, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, cost estimating, NEPA and permitting support, and design services for the phased rehabilitation of an intermodal terminal.
contracting_authority: Kitsap Transit, Port Orchard, Washington, USA. Contact: Patrick Rogers. Phone: 360-479-6960. Fax: 360-377-7086. Email: patrickr@kitsaptransit.com.
